items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I looked him up but I couldn't find him.

ctx.x: And we had a boy named Chester Clark who played a beautiful trumpet, beautiful tone. Everybody had big tones in this band. They could play waltzes. They could play that pretty music, and could play hot music too. Also had a boy in the band named Herbert "Peanuts" Holland. Peanuts played with Trent's band. He was what you call a hot jazz trumpet player. He could play high. He could -- he played -- he was exciting to hear. He left Trent's band and he joined -- I'll recall his name in a minute.
Anyway Peanuts Holland -- I was in Stockholm, Sweden -- that's where he'd lived for years -- and I was there in '71.
I looked him up but I couldn't find him. But I hear that he's back there and he's been sick. I hear that he's back there and he's been sick. Oh, he played with Charlie Barnett's orchestra.
